title: What Is Azure and Getting Started

options.text: A programming language used in Azure
A billing and management boundary that resources are created inside
The web GUI for managing Azure

questions.explanation: A subscription is a billing and management boundary. Resources are created inside it and their usage is billed to it; you can have several (e.g., dev and production).

questions.prompt: Which of these are ways to interact with Azure? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: All four are valid ways to work with Azure. They ultimately call the same Azure REST API.

questions.prompt: The Azure CLI command that signs you in is `az ____`.
questions.explanation: `az login` opens a browser to authenticate; then `az account show` displays your active subscription.

questions.prompt: Order the Azure hierarchy from broadest to most specific.
questions.explanation: Identity and billing flow account → subscription → resource group → resource.

questions.prompt: Match each tool or term to what it is.

pairs.right: Web GUI for exploring and managing Azure
Command-line tool whose commands start with az
A signed-in shell built into the browser
Your organization's directory of users and groups

questions.explanation: The portal is the GUI; the CLI is command-line (az); Cloud Shell is a ready-to-use browser shell; a tenant is your Microsoft Entra directory.
